parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm at about 50–55 bpm with narrow QRS complexes, a vertical axis, normal R-wave progression, upright T waves in the inferior and lateral leads, and only minor J-point or ST elevation in V2–V3. That elevation falls short of STEMI thresholds, and there are no bundle branch block, pre-excitation, AV block, hypertrophy-voltage or infarct patterns.
